tool.name: Split.groups
tool.description: Generates a fasta file for each group
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$name' name.dat && ln -s '$count' count.dat && ## mothur names the per-group files after the *extension of the input file*, ## so pin it to .fasta to keep the output names stable ln -s '$fasta' fasta.fasta && ln -s '$group' group.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #if $name: #silent $mothur_args.append("name=name.dat") #end if #if $groups: #silent $mothur_args.append("groups=" + str(str($groups).replace(",","-"))) #end if #if $count: #silent $mothur_args.append("count=count.dat") #end if #silent $mothur_args.append("fasta=fasta.fasta") #silent $mothur_args.append("group=group.dat")
echo 'split.groups(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log

param.label: fasta - Fasta to split by group
name - Names to split by group

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The split.groups_ command reads a fasta file and group_ file and generates a fasta file for each group in the groupfile. A name_ file can also be split into groups.
.. _group: https://mothur.org/wiki/group_file/ .. _name: https://mothur.org/wiki/name_file/ .. _split.groups: https://mothur.org/wiki/split.groups/
